name: codex-usage-bar-vscode
description: Shows Codex 5-hour and weekly usage in the VS Code status bar, with progress bars, reset countdowns, and color alerts.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs the official local Codex executable to read account rate limits.

enumDescriptions: Show both the 5-hour and weekly limits
codexUsageBar.displayMode.description: Which rate limit to display in the status bar

enumDescriptions: Progress bar on the 5-hour and weekly limits
Progress bar on the 5-hour limit only
Progress bar on the weekly limit only
codexUsageBar.progressBar.description: Which limits show a visual progress bar

codexUsageBar.percentageMode.description: Whether percentages represent used or remaining quota

codexUsageBar.showProviderLabel.description: Show the Codex provider name in the status bar so it is distinct from other usage extensions

enumDescriptions: Place Codex Usage Bar on the left side of the status bar
Place Codex Usage Bar on the right side of the status bar
codexUsageBar.alignment.description: Which side of the VS Code status bar contains the Codex usage item

enumDescriptions: Respect the normal ordering of left-side status items
Place Codex before built-in Git and extension status items
codexUsageBar.leftPosition.description: Ordering used when Codex Usage Bar is aligned to the left

codexUsageBar.codexPath.markdownDescription: Path to the official `codex` executable. The extension also discovers the executable bundled with the official OpenAI extension.

codexUsageBar.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh Codex usage (minimum 15 seconds)

commands.title: Codex Usage: Switch Display Mode (5h / Weekly / Both)

scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:marketplace && npm run publish:openvsx
